job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No education | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree

03. Have you completed at least 12 semester or 18 quarter units in computer-related courses from a recognized college, vocational or trade school, or equivalent specialized training program? Options: Yes | No

04. If you responded yes to Question 3, please list the computer-related courses you completed. For each course, please include: a) The name of the college, vocational or trade school, or equivalent specialized training program where you completed the course b) The name of the course and the course number c) The number of units of the course completed and if it was semester units or quarter units If you responded no to Question 3, list "n/a".
05. Do you posses a valid, not expired CompTIA A+ certification? Please Note: Proof of certification will be required. Options: Yes | No

06. How many years of experience do you have installing and troubleshooting personal computing hardware, software, and related peripheral equipment? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 years but less than 3 years | 3 years but less than 4 years | 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

07. Please describe your experience with installing and troubleshooting personal computing hardware, software, and related peripheral equipment. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

08. How many years of experience do you have in the LACOE job classification of Technology Support Technician I? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 year but less than 3 years | 3 year but less than 4 years | 4 year but less than 5 years | 5 or more years
09. Do you have a valid California driver's license? Options: Yes | No
10. The current vacancy is at International Polytechnic High School in Pomona, CA. Are you willing and able to report to International Polytechnic High School in Pomona, CA? Options: Yes | No
